authors.institution: Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University

title_en: Efficient Learning of Deep State Space Models via Importance Smoothing
title_zh: 通过重要性平滑高效学习深度状态空间模型

sentences.en: Latent state space systems are ubiquitous in statistical modelling, arising naturally when time series are observed through noisy measurements.
sentences.zh: 潜在状态空间系统在统计建模中无处不在，当时间序列通过含噪测量被观测时自然出现。

sentences.en: However, training deep state space models (DSSMs) at scale remains difficult.
sentences.zh: 然而，大规模训练深度状态空间模型（DSSM）仍然困难。

sentences.en: Two largely distinct strategies have emerged for training DSSMs.
sentences.zh: 训练 DSSM 已出现两种大体不同的策略。

sentences.en: The first, auto-encoding DSSMs, trains generative models by optimising a variational lower bound.
sentences.zh: 第一种，自动编码 DSSM，通过优化变分下界训练生成模型。

sentences.en: The second backpropagates through the outputs of classical sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithms.
sentences.zh: 第二种通过经典序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）算法的输出反向传播。

sentences.en: Such approaches can train DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks, but their inherently sequential forward passes scale poorly on modern hardware.
sentences.zh: 此类方法可以为判别与生成任务训练 DSSM，但它们固有顺序的前向传播在现代硬件上扩展不佳。

sentences.en: We propose \emph{parallel variational Monte Carlo} (PVMC), a new training method that bridges these paradigms and robustly trains DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*并行变分蒙特卡洛*（PVMC），一种弥合这些范式、稳健训练 DSSM 以用于判别与生成任务的新训练方法。

sentences.en: Across a set of benchmark experiments, PVMC matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance while training $10\times$ faster than the fastest competing SMC-based approach.
sentences.zh: 在一组基准实验中，PVMC 匹敌或超越最先进性能，同时训练速度比最快的 SMC 竞争方法快 10\times。

title_en: Efficient LLM Moderation with Multi-Layer Latent Prototypes
title_zh: 通过多层潜在原型进行高效大语言模型内容审核

sentences.en: Although modern LLMs are aligned with human values during post-training, robust moderation remains essential to prevent harmful outputs at deployment time.
sentences.zh: 虽然现代 LLM 在后训练期间与人类价值观对齐，但稳健审核对于在部署时防止有害输出仍然至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing approaches suffer from performance-efficiency trade-offs and are difficult to customize to user-specific requirements.
sentences.zh: 现有方法遭受性能-效率权衡，并且难以针对用户特定需求定制。

sentences.en: Motivated by this gap, we introduce Multi-Layer Prototype Moderator (MLPM), a lightweight and highly customizable input moderation tool.
sentences.zh: 受这一差距激励，我们引入多层原型审核器（MLPM），一个轻量级且高度可定制的输入审核工具。

sentences.en: We propose leveraging prototypes of intermediate representations across multiple layers to improve moderation quality while maintaining high efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们提议利用跨多层中间表示的原型来改善审核质量，同时保持高效率。

sentences.en: By design, our method adds negligible overhead to the generation pipeline and can be seamlessly applied to any model.
sentences.zh: 通过设计，我们的方法为生成流水线带来可忽略开销，并可无缝应用于任何模型。

sentences.en: MLPM achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse moderation benchmarks and demonstrates strong scalability across model families of various sizes.
sentences.zh: MLPM 在多样审核基准上实现最先进性能，并跨各种大小的模型家族展现出强可扩展性。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that it integrates smoothly into end-to-end moderation pipelines and further improves response safety when combined with output moderation techniques.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明它可以平稳整合进端到端审核流水线，并在与输出审核技术结合时进一步改善响应安全性。

sentences.en: Overall, our work provides a practical and adaptable solution for safe, robust, and efficient LLM deployment.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的工作为安全、稳健且高效的 LLM 部署提供实用且自适应的解决方案。

title_en: Efficient Mismatch-Tolerant Coding for Model-Driven Compression
title_zh: 用于模型驱动压缩的高效失配容忍编码

sentences.en: A central insight in lossless data compression is the close connection between probabilistic next- symbol prediction and efficient sequence compression, whereby predictive models can be combined with classical coding techniques to achieve strong compression performance.
sentences.zh: 无损数据压缩的一个核心洞见是概率性下一符号预测与高效序列压缩之间的紧密联系，由此预测模型可以与经典编码技术结合以实现强压缩性能。

sentences.en: Applying this approach with powerful modern learned models, such as LLMs, has been shown to achieve markedly better compression than traditional techniques across a wide range of domains.
sentences.zh: 将此方法应用于诸如 LLM 的强大现代学习模型，已被证明在许多领域实现比传统技术明显更好的压缩。

sentences.en: However, significant practical challenges remain, including model non-determinism, in which a model produces different predictions on different machines despite identical parameters and inputs; such mismatches between the encoder and decoder can lead to complete decoding failure.
sentences.zh: 然而，重大实际挑战仍然存在，包括模型非确定性，即模型在不同机器上产生不同预测尽管参数与输入相同；编码器与解码器之间的此类失配可能导致完全解码失败。

sentences.en: Probability Matching Interval Coding (PMATIC) was recently introduced as a drop-in framework for mismatch-robust coding and shown to enable reliable compression and decompression in the presence of bounded prediction mismatch (Adler & Tang, 2026).
sentences.zh: 概率匹配区间编码（PMATIC）近期被引入作为失配稳健编码的即插即用框架，并被证明在有界预测失配下实现可靠压缩与解压（Adler & Tang, 2026）。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a generalization of PMATIC that allows the incorpo- ration of tight theoretical results into the design and more flexible parameter optimization, resulting in substantial improvements in compression efficiency and robustness.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 PMATIC 的一个推广，它允许将紧密理论结果纳入设计并实现更灵活的参数优化，从而在压缩效率与稳健性上带来显著改进。

title_en: Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate
title_zh: 通过置信度引导自适应辩论实现高效多智能体推理

sentences.en: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent.
sentences.zh: 多智能体辩论已显示出改善大语言模型推理的前景，然而近期理论表明其益处高度依赖区间。

sentences.en: While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable.
sentences.zh: 虽然交互可以在校正条件下放大有信息量的信号，但对称辩论动态在期望上中性，常常使多数投票更可取得。

sentences.en: We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure.
sentences.zh: 我们通过主张辩论仅在正确时机并带适当结构被调用时才有效，来调和这些观点。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 LASE：领导者自适应结构化互动，一个以领导者为中心的多智能体辩论框架，它仅在非中性区间选择性地启动交互。

sentences.en: LASE introduces an asymmetric leader–supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise.
sentences.zh: LASE 引入一个不对称的领导者-支持者架构，支持有向信息流与选择性信号放大，而在其他情况下默认为简单聚合。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多样推理基准的实验表明，LASE 以接近单智能体的词元成本实现多智能体级性能，相较静态辩论与投票基线大幅改善效率。

authors.name: Junhyun Lee
authors.institution: Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, Noah's Farm

title_en: Efficient Multi-modal Dataset Distillation via Analytic Parameter Matching
title_zh: 通过解析参数匹配实现高效多模态数据集蒸馏

sentences.en: Multi-modal dataset distillation (MDD) seeks to compress large-scale multi-modal datasets into a compact set of synthetic pairs.
sentences.zh: 多模态数据集蒸馏（MDD）旨在将大规模多模态数据集压缩为紧凑的合成对集合。

sentences.en: Existing methods employ a dual-trajectory matching framework to align the teacher and student models within each modality.
sentences.zh: 现有方法采用双轨迹匹配框架，在每种模态内对齐教师与学生模型。

sentences.en: While effective, this paradigm incurs non-negligible memory and computational overhead due to the checkpoint storage and bi-level optimization over synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 虽然有效，但这一范式因检查点存储与对合成数据的双层优化而招致不可忽略的内存与计算开销。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose analytic parameter matching (APM), which theoretically derives the analytic parameters of modal projectors to replace the inner-loop optimization, and then aligns the analytic projector parameters of teacher and student models.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出解析参数匹配（APM），它从理论上推导模态投影器的解析参数以取代内环优化，然后对齐教师与学生模型的解析投影器参数。

sentences.en: APM offers two key advantages: (1) it replaces checkpoint-intensive storage with only two cached matrices, significantly reducing memory consumption; and (2) it computes analytic parameters in a single forward pass, thereby avoiding costly bi-level optimization.
sentences.zh: APM 提供两个关键优势：（1）它用仅两个缓存矩阵取代检查点密集的存储，显著减少内存消耗；并且（2）它在单次前向传播中计算解析参数，从而避免昂贵的双层优化。

sentences.en: Empirically, APM achieves up to 65$\times$ storage reduction and 9.6$\times$ faster distillation, while scaling to 1,000 synthetic pairs.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，APM 实现至多 65\times 的存储减少与 9.6\times 的更快蒸馏，同时扩展到 1,000 个合成对。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on image-text and audio-text benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of APM in cross-modal retrieval tasks, e.g., 12.8 IR@1 and 17.8 TR@1 in Flickr30k with 100 synthetic pairs.
sentences.zh: 在图像-文本与音频-文本基准上的大量实验证明了 APM 在跨模态检索任务中的有效性，例如在 Flickr30k 上用 100 个合成对实现 12.8 IR@1 与 17.8 TR@1。

sentences.en: Moreover, APM exhibits notable generalization performance in cross-architecture evaluation and zero-shot classification tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，APM 在跨架构评估与零样本分类任务中展现出显著的泛化性能。

title_en: Efficient Multi-round LLM Inference over Disaggregated Serving
title_zh: 分离式服务上的高效多轮大语言模型推理

sentences.en: With the rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs), multi-round workflows, such as autonomous agents and iterative retrieval, have become increasingly prevalent.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速演化，诸如自主智能体与迭代检索的多轮工作流正变得日益普遍。

sentences.en: However, this raises hurdles for serving LLMs under prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation, a widely adopted paradigm that separates the compute-bound prefill phase and memory-bound decode phase onto individual resources.
sentences.zh: 然而，这在预填充-解码（PD）分离式服务（一种将计算受限的预填充阶段与内存受限的解码阶段分离到各自资源的广泛采用范式）下为服务 LLM 制造障碍。

sentences.en: Specifically, existing systems overlook the interleaved prefill-decode workload pattern in multi-round inference, leading to sub-optimal handling of the incremental prefill workloads and model deployment for the two phases.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，现有系统忽视多轮推断中的交错预填充-解码工作负载模式，导致对增量预填充工作负载与两阶段模型部署的次优处理。

sentences.en: In this work, we present AMPD, a brand new disaggregated serving framework for multi-round LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 AMPD，一个用于多轮 LLM 推断的全新分离式服务框架。

sentences.en: The core of AMPD is to coordinate the prefill workloads based on real-time workloads by adaptively determining where to carry out these workloads and how they are scheduled, in order to maximize service level objective (SLO) attainment.
sentences.zh: AMPD 的核心是基于实时工作负载协调预填充工作负载，通过自适应确定在何处执行这些工作负载及如何调度它们，以最大化服务水平目标（SLO）达成率。

sentences.en: In addition, we tailor a planning algorithm for our scenario, facilitating the deduction of optimal resource allocation and parallel strategies for the two phases.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为我们的场景量身定制一个规划算法，支持推导两阶段的最优资源分配与并行策略。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that AMPD substantially improves SLO attainment compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，相较最先进基线，AMPD 大幅改善 SLO 达成率。

title_en: Efficient Neural Controlled Differential Equations via Attentive Kernel Smoothing
title_zh: 通过注意力核平滑实现高效神经受控微分方程

sentences.en: Neural Controlled Differential Equations (Neural CDEs) provide a powerful continuous-time framework for sequence modeling, yet the roughness of the driving control path often restricts their efficiency.
sentences.zh: 神经常微分方程（Neural CDE）为序列建模提供强大的连续时间框架，然而驱动控制路径的粗糙性常常限制其效率。

sentences.en: Standard splines introduce high-frequency variations that force adaptive solvers to take excessively small steps, driving up the Number of Function Evaluations (NFE).
sentences.zh: 标准样条引入高频变化，迫使自适应求解器采取过小步长，推高函数评估数（NFE）。

sentences.en: We propose a novel approach to Neural CDE path construction that replaces exact interpolation with Kernel and Gaussian Process (GP) smoothing, enabling explicit control over trajectory regularity.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种 Neural CDE 路径构建的新颖方法，它用核与高斯过程（GP）平滑取代精确插值，实现对轨迹正则性的显式控制。

sentences.en: To recover details lost during smoothing, we propose an attention-based Multi-View CDE (MV-CDE) and its convolutional extension (MVC-CDE), which employ learnable queries to inform path reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 为恢复平滑期间丢失的细节，我们提出基于注意力的多视图 CDE（MV-CDE）及其卷积扩展（MVC-CDE），它们采用可学习查询来告知路径重建。

sentences.en: This framework allows the model to distribute representational capacity across multiple trajectories, each capturing distinct temporal patterns.
sentences.zh: 这一框架允许模型跨多条轨迹分布表示能力，每条捕获不同的时间模式。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that our method, MVC-CDE with GP, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while significantly reducing NFEs and total inference time compared to spline-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，我们的方法 MVC-CDE（带 GP）实现最先进准确率，同时相较基于样条的基线显著减少 NFE 与总推断时间。

title_en: Efficient numeracy in language models through single-token number embeddings
title_zh: 通过单词元数字嵌入提升语言模型数值处理效率

sentences.en: To drive progress in science and engineering, large language models (LLMs) must be able to process large amounts of numerical data and solve long calculations efficiently.
sentences.zh: 为推动科学与工程进展，大语言模型（LLM）必须能够处理大量数值数据并高效求解长计算。

sentences.en: This is currently only possible through the use of external tools or extensive reasoning chains, either weakening the numerical representations of LLMs or limiting the length of problems they can solve.
sentences.zh: 这目前只能通过使用外部工具或广泛推理链实现，要么削弱 LLM 的数值表示，要么限制它们能求解的问题长度。

sentences.en: We show that frontier LLMs require excessive amounts of reasoning tokens to solve even basic calculations, which is exacerbated by their tokenization strategies that split single numbers into multiple tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，前沿 LLM 即使求解基本计算也需要过多推理词元，而其将单个数字拆分为多个词元的词元化策略使这一问题加剧。

sentences.en: This motivates the need for efficient and effective single-token number encodings.
sentences.zh: 这引发了对高效且有效的单词元数字编码的需求。

sentences.en: We introduce a set of desiderata for such encodings and show that existing approaches fail to fulfill them.
sentences.zh: 我们为此类编码引入一组期望性质，并表明现有方法未能满足它们。

sentences.en: To address these shortcomings, we propose BitTokens, a novel encoding strategy that represents any number as a single token using its IEEE 754 binary floating-point representation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些不足，我们提出 BitTokens，一种使用其 IEEE 754 二进制浮点表示将任意数字表示为单个词元的新编码策略。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments we show that our BitTokens allow even small language models to learn algorithms that solve basic arithmetic operations nearly perfectly.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们表明我们的 BitTokens 甚至使小语言模型能够学习近乎完美求解基本算术运算的算法。

sentences.en: This newly gained efficiency could expand the length and complexity of problems language models can solve.
sentences.zh: 这种新获得的高效性可以扩展语言模型能求解问题的长度与复杂度。

title_en: Efficient Online Influence Maximization under the Independent Cascade Model with Node-Level Feedback
title_zh: 节点级反馈下独立级联模型的高效在线影响力最大化

sentences.en: Influence maximization is an important research area in social network analysis, where the goal is to select a small set of seed nodes so as to maximize the expected spread of influence under a stochastic diffusion process.
sentences.zh: 影响最大化是社会网络分析中的一个重要研究领域，其目标是在随机扩散过程下选择一小组种子节点以最大化期望影响扩散。

sentences.en: Classical approximation algorithms for this problem rely on full knowledge of the underlying influence probabilities and operate in an offline manner.
sentences.zh: 针对该问题的经典逼近算法依赖影响概率的完全知识，并以离线方式运作。

sentences.en: In many real-world settings, however, these probabilities are unknown and must be learned from data, raising the question: \emph{can one still obtain strong performance guarantees while simultaneously learning the diffusion model parameters through repeated interactions?}     In this paper, we study the problem of \emph{online influence maximization} under the independent cascade model, where influence probabilities are unknown and feedback is limited to \emph{node-level} activation outcomes.
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多现实情境中，这些概率未知，必须从数据学习，这引发问题：*能否在通过重复交互同时学习扩散模型参数的情况下，仍然获得强性能保证？* 在本文中，我们研究独立级联模型下的*在线影响最大化*问题，其中影响概率未知，反馈限于*节点级*激活结果。

sentences.en: Prior work relies on a \emph{pair oracle} which needs to perform a joint optimization over seed sets and feasible parameters.
sentences.zh: 先前工作依赖一个*对预言机*，它需要对种子集与可行参数执行联合优化。

sentences.en: This oracle is  difficult to implement in practice and it was open whether one can achieve sublinear regret using only a \emph{standard} offline oracle.
sentences.zh: 该预言机在实践中难以实现，并且仅用*标准*离线预言机能否实现次线性遗憾的问题仍然是开放的。

sentences.en: We resolve this question by designing an online learning algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret using only a \emph{standard} offline oracle.
sentences.zh: 我们通过设计一个仅用*标准*离线预言机实现 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾的在线学习算法来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: Finally, we validate our theoretical results via experiments on real and synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们通过在真实与合成数据上的实验验证理论结果。

title_en: Efficient Online Variational Estimation via Monte Carlo Sampling
title_zh: 通过蒙特卡洛采样实现高效在线变分估计

sentences.en: This article addresses online variational estimation in parametric state-space models.
sentences.zh: 本文应对参数化状态空间模型中的在线变分估计。

sentences.en: We propose a new procedure for efficiently computing the evidence lower bound and its gradient in a streaming-data setting, where observations arrive sequentially.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新流程，用于在观测序贯到达的流式数据情境中高效计算证据下界及其梯度。

sentences.en: The algorithm allows for the simultaneous training of the model parameters and the distribution of the latent states given the observations.
sentences.zh: 该算法支持在给定观测的情况下同时训练模型参数与潜在状态的分布。

sentences.en: It is based on i.i.d. Monte Carlo sampling, coupled with a well-chosen deep architecture, enabling both computational efficiency and flexibility.
sentences.zh: 它基于 i.i.d. 蒙特卡洛采样，配以精心选择的深层架构，同时实现计算效率与灵活性。

sentences.en: The performance of the method is illustrated on both synthetic data and real-world air-quality data.
sentences.zh: 该方法的性能在合成数据与真实世界空气质量数据上得到展示。

sentences.en: The proposed approach is theoretically motivated by the existence of an asymptotic contrast function and the ergodicity of the underlying Markov chain, and applies more generally to the computation of additive expectations under posterior distributions in state-space models.
sentences.zh: 所提出的方法在理论上由渐近对比函数的存在性与底层马尔可夫链的遍历性所激励，并更一般地适用于计算状态空间模型中后验分布下的加性期望。

title_en: Efficient Parallel Samplers for Recurrent-Depth Models
title_zh: 循环深度模型的高效并行采样器

sentences.en: Language models with recurrent depth, also referred to as universal or looped when considering transformers, are defined by the capacity to increase their computation through the repetition of layers.
sentences.zh: 带递归深度、在考虑 Transformer 时也称为通用或循环的语言模型，其特征是通过层重复增加计算的能力。

sentences.en: Recent efforts in pretraining have demonstrated that these architectures can scale to modern language modeling tasks while exhibiting advantages in reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期预训练工作已证明这些架构可以扩展到现代语言建模任务，同时在推理任务中展现出优势。

sentences.en: In this work, we examine the relationship between recurrent-depth models and diffusion language models.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们考察递归深度模型与扩散语言模型之间的关系。

sentences.en: Building on their similarities, we develop a new diffusion forcing sampler for these models to accelerate generation.
sentences.zh: 基于它们的相似性，我们为这些模型开发一个新的扩散强制采样器以加速生成。

sentences.en: The sampler advances by decoding new tokens at every forward pass of the model, while the latent states of these tokens can be further refined in parallel through recurrence.
sentences.zh: 该采样器在模型的每次前向传播时解码新词元，而这些词元的潜在状态可以通过递归并行进一步精炼。

sentences.en: Theoretically, generation with our sampler is strictly more expressive than the baseline autoregressive generation using the same time budget on modern hardware.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，在现代硬件上使用相同时间预算，用我们的采样器生成严格比基线自回归生成更具表达力。

sentences.en: Moreover, this sampler, based on principles from diffusion literature, can be directly applied to existing 3.5B recurrent-depth transformers without any tuning, leading to up to a 5x speedup.
sentences.zh: 此外，这一基于扩散文献原理的采样器，可以直接应用于现有的 3.5B 递归深度 Transformer 而无需任何调优，带来至多 5\times 的加速。

title_en: Efficient Prediction of SO(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Matrices via SO(2) Local Frames
title_zh: 通过 SO(2) 局部标架高效预测 SO(3) 等变哈密顿矩阵

sentences.en: We consider the task of predicting Hamiltonian matrices to accelerate electronic structure calculations, which plays an important role in physics, chemistry, and materials science.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑预测 Hamiltonian 矩阵以加速电子结构计算的任务，这在物理学、化学与材料科学中起重要作用。

sentences.en: Motivated by the inherent relationship between the off-diagonal blocks of the Hamiltonian matrix and the SO(2) local frame, we propose a novel and efficient network, called QHNetV2, that achieves global SO(3) equivariance without the costly SO(3) Clebsch–Gordan tensor products.
sentences.zh: 受 Hamiltonian 矩阵非对角块与 SO(2) 局部坐标架之间内在关系的激励，我们提出一个新颖且高效的网络，称为 QHNetV2，它在没有昂贵 SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan 张量乘积的情况下实现全局 SO(3) 等变性。

sentences.en: This is achieved by introducing a set of new efficient and powerful SO(2)-equivariant operations and performing all off-diagonal feature updates and message passing within SO(2) local frames, thereby eliminating the need of SO(3) tensor products.
sentences.zh: 这是通过引入一组新的高效且强大的 SO(2)-等变运算，并在 SO(2) 局部坐标架内执行所有非对角特征更新与消息传递，从而消除 SO(3) 张量乘积的需求而实现的。

sentences.en: Moreover, a continuous SO(2) tensor product is performed within the SO(2) local frame at each node to fuse node features.
sentences.zh: 此外，在每个节点的 SO(2) 局部坐标架内执行一个连续的 SO(2) 张量乘积以融合节点特征。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the large QH9 and MD17 datasets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance across a wide range of molecular structures and trajectories, highlighting its strong generalization capability.
sentences.zh: 在大型 QH9 与 MD17 数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的模型在广泛的分子结构与轨迹上实现卓越性能，凸显其强泛化能力。

sentences.en: The proposed SO(2) operations on SO(2) local frames offer a promising direction for scalable and symmetry-aware learning of electronic structures.
sentences.zh: 所提出的 SO(2) 局部坐标架上 SO(2) 运算为可扩展且对称感知的电子结构学习提供有前景方向。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available as part of the AIRS library (https://github.com/divelab/AIRS/).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码作为 AIRS 库的一部分公开可用（https://github.com/divelab/AIRS/）。

title_en: Efficient Preference Poisoning Attack on Offline RLHF
title_zh: 针对离线 RLHF 的高效偏好投毒攻击

sentences.en: Offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) train on a pre-collected preference dataset,  which makes them vulnerable to preference poisoning attack.
sentences.zh: 离线基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）流水线（如直接偏好优化（DPO））在预收集的偏好数据集上训练，这使它们容易受到偏好毒化攻击。

sentences.en: We study label flip attacks against log-linear DPO.
sentences.zh: 我们研究针对对数线性 DPO 的标签翻转攻击。

sentences.en: We first illustrate that flipping one preference label induces a parameter-independent shift in the DPO gradient.
sentences.zh: 我们首先说明，翻转一个偏好标签会在 DPO 梯度中诱导与参数无关的偏移。

sentences.en: Using this key property, we can then convert the targeted poisoning problem into a structured binary sparse approximation problem.
sentences.zh: 利用这一关键性质，我们然后将定向毒化问题转化为结构化的二元稀疏逼近问题。

sentences.en: To solve this problem, we develop two attack methods: Binary-Aware Lattice Attack (BAL-A) and Binary Matching Pursuit Attack (BMP-A).
sentences.zh: 为解决该问题，我们开发两种攻击方法：二元感知格攻击（BAL-A）与二元匹配追踪攻击（BMP-A）。

sentences.en: BAL-A embeds the binary flip selection problem into a binary-aware lattice and applies Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovász reduction and Babai's nearest plane algorithm;  we provide sufficient conditions that enforce binary coefficients and recover the minimum-flip objective.
sentences.zh: BAL-A 将二元翻转选择问题嵌入一个二元感知格，并应用 Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovász 归约与 Babai 最近平面算法；我们提供强制二元系数并恢复最小翻转目标的充分条件。

sentences.en: BMP-A adapts binary matching pursuit to our non-normalized gradient dictionary and yields coherence-based recovery guarantees and robustness (impossibility) certificates for $K$-flip budgets.
sentences.zh: BMP-A 将二元匹配追踪适配到我们的非归一化梯度字典，并为 K-翻转预算产生基于相干性的恢复保证与稳健性（不可能性）证书。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic dictionaries and the Stanford Human Preferences dataset validate the theory and highlight how dictionary geometry governs attack success.
sentences.zh: 在合成字典与斯坦福人类偏好数据集上的实验验证了理论，并凸显字典几何如何支配攻击成功率。

title_en: Efficient privacy loss accounting for subsampling and random allocation
title_zh: 子采样与随机分配中的高效隐私损失核算

sentences.en: We consider the privacy amplification properties of a sampling scheme in which a user’s data is used in $k$ steps chosen randomly and uniformly from a sequence (or set) of $t$ steps.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑一种采样方案的隐私放大性质，其中用户的数据被用于从 t 个步骤的序列（或集合）中随机均匀选择的 k 个步骤。

sentences.en: This sampling scheme has been recently applied in the context of differentially private optimization [Chua et al., 2024a, Choquette-Choo et al., 2025] and communication-efficient high-dimensional private aggregation [Asi et al., 2025], where it was shown to have utility advantages over the standard Poisson sampling.
sentences.zh: 该采样方案近来已被应用于差分私有优化（Chua 等人，2024a；Choquette-Choo 等人，2025）与通信高效高维私有聚合（Asi 等人，2025），在那里被证明比标准 Poisson 采样具有效用优势。

sentences.en: Theoretical analyses of this sampling scheme [Feldman and Shenfeld, 2025, Dong et al., 2025] lead to bounds that are close to those of Poisson sampling, yet still have two significant shortcomings.
sentences.zh: 对该采样方案的理论分析（Feldman 和 Shenfeld, 2025；Dong 等人，2025）产生接近 Poisson 采样的界，但仍有两个显著缺点。

sentences.en: First, in many practical settings, the resulting privacy parameters are not tight due to the approximation steps in the analysis.
sentences.zh: 首先，在许多实际情境中，因分析中的近似步骤，所得的隐私参数不紧。

sentences.en: Second, the computed parameters are either the hockey stick or Rényi divergence, both of which introduce overheads when used in privacy loss accounting.
sentences.zh: 其次，计算的参数要么是曲棍球棒散度要么是 Rényi 散度，两者在用于隐私损失核算时都引入开销。

sentences.en: In this work, we demonstrate that the privacy loss distribution (PLD) of random allocation applied to any differentially private algorithm can be computed efficiently.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们证明应用于任何差分私有算法的随机分配的隐私损失分布（PLD）可以高效计算。

sentences.en: When applied to the Gaussian mechanism, our results demonstrate that the privacy-utility trade-off for random allocation is at least as good as that of Poisson subsampling.
sentences.zh: 当应用于 Gaussian 机制时，我们的结果表明随机分配的隐私-效用权衡至少与 Poisson 子采样一样好。

sentences.en: In particular, random allocation is better suited for training via DP-SGD.
sentences.zh: 特别是，随机分配更适合用于通过 DP-SGD 训练。

sentences.en: To support these computations, our work develops new tools for general privacy loss accounting based on a notion of PLD realization.
sentences.zh: 为支持这些计算，我们的工作基于 PLD 实现的概念为一般隐私损失核算开发新工具。

sentences.en: This notion allows us to extend accurate privacy loss accounting to subsampling which previously required manual noise-mechanism-specific analysis.
sentences.zh: 这一概念使我们能够将精确隐私损失核算扩展到先前需要手动噪声机制特定分析的子采样。

title_en: Efficient Public Verification of Private ML via Regularization
title_zh: 通过正则化高效公开验证隐私机器学习

sentences.en: Training with differential privacy (DP) guarantees dataset members that they cannot be identified by users of the released model.
sentences.zh: 带差分隐私（DP）的训练向数据集成员保证他们无法被发布模型的用户识别。

sentences.en: However, those data providers, and, in general, the public, lack methods to efficiently verify that models trained on their data satisfy DP guarantees.
sentences.zh: 然而，那些数据提供者以及一般而言公众，缺乏高效验证在其数据上训练的模型是否满足 DP 保证的方法。

sentences.en: The amount of compute needed to verify DP guarantees for current algorithms scales with the amount of computation required to train the model.
sentences.zh: 为当前算法验证 DP 保证所需的计算量，随训练模型所需计算量而扩展。

sentences.en: In this paper we design the first DP algorithm with near optimal privacy-utility trade-offs but whose DP guarantees can be verified cheaper than training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们设计首个 DP 算法，它具有近最优隐私-效用权衡，而其 DP 保证的验证成本低于训练。

sentences.en: We focus on DP stochastic convex optimization (DP-SCO), where optimal privacy-utility trade-offs are known.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于 DP 随机凸优化（DP-SCO），其中最优隐私-效用权衡已知。

sentences.en: Here we show we can obtain tight privacy-utility trade-offs by privately minimizing a series of regularized objectives and only using the standard DP composition bound.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们表明通过私有最小化一系列正则化目标并仅使用标准 DP 复合界，可以获得紧隐私-效用权衡。

sentences.en: Crucially, this method can be verified with much less compute than training.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，此方法可以用比训练少得多的计算验证。

sentences.en: This leads to the first known DP-SCO algorithm with near optimal privacy-utility whose DP verification scales better than training cost, significantly reducing verification costs on large datasets.
sentences.zh: 这导致首个已知的 DP-SCO 算法，其 DP 验证的扩展优于训练成本，在大型数据集上显著降低验证成本。

title_en: Efficient Reasoning with Hidden Thinking
title_zh: 利用隐藏思考实现高效推理

sentences.en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has become a powerful framework for improving complex problem-solving capabilities in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 思维链（CoT）推理已成为改善多模态大语言模型（MLLM）复杂问题求解能力的强大框架。

sentences.en: However, the verbose nature of textual reasoning introduces significant inefficiencies.
sentences.zh: 然而，文本推理的冗长性质引入显著低效。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose**Heima** (as hidden llama), an effective CoT compression framework that condenses lengthy CoTs into a small set of abstract thinking tokens, preserving essential reasoning while removing redundancy.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 **Heima**（隐藏大模型的谐音），一个有效的 CoT 压缩框架，它将冗长的 CoT 压缩为一小组抽象思考词元，在去除冗余的同时保留必要推理。

sentences.en: We then conduct a theoretical analysis from an information-theoretic perspective, quantifying the information gap induced by compression, showing that reasoning capability is preserved when non-trivial mutual information is retained.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们从信息论视角进行理论分析，量化压缩诱导的信息差距，表明在保留非平凡互信息时推理能力得以保持。

sentences.en: To further explore and quantify this information gap, we design the adaptive interpreter that maps thinking tokens back to variable-length textual sequences, thereby reconstructing the reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 为进一步探索并量化这一信息差距，我们设计自适应解释器，将思考词元映射回可变长度的文本序列，从而重建推理过程。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Heima improves reasoning efficiency, while maintaining or even achieving better zero-shot accuracy.
sentences.zh: 跨多样推理基准的实验表明，Heima 改善推理效率，同时保持甚至实现更好的零样本准确率。

sentences.en: Moreover, the interpreter reconstructs coherent reasoning progresses from compressed thinking tokens, revealing that the information gap is minimal and validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
sentences.zh: 此外，解释器从压缩思考词元重建连贯的推理过程，揭示信息差距极小，并验证所提出框架的有效性。

sentences.en: This work paves the way for scalable latent reasoning models and advances our understanding of efficient reasoning processes in large models.
sentences.zh: 这项工作为可扩展潜在推理模型铺平道路，并推进我们对大型模型中高效推理过程的理解。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/shawnricecake/Heima
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/shawnricecake/Heima。

title_en: Efficient RL Training for LLMs with Experience Replay
title_zh: 结合经验回放的高效大语言模型强化学习训练

sentences.en: While Experience Replay—the practice of storing rollouts and reusing them multiple times during training—is a foundational technique in general RL, it remains largely unexplored in LLM post-training due to the prevailing belief that fresh, on-policy data is essential for high performance.
sentences.zh: 虽然经验重放（存储 rollout 并在训练期间多次复用它们的做法）是通用 RL 的基础技术，但由于“新鲜、在策略数据对高性能至关重要”的主流信念，它在 LLM 后训练中在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we challenge this assumption.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们挑战这一假设。

sentences.en: We present a systematic study of replay buffers for LLM post-training, formalizing the optimal design as a trade-off between staleness-induced variance, sample diversity and the high computational cost of generation.
sentences.zh: 我们对 LLM 后训练的重放缓冲进行系统性研究，将最优设计形式化为陈旧诱导方差、样本多样性与生成高计算成本之间的权衡。

sentences.en: We show that strict on-policy sampling is suboptimal when generation is expensive.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当生成昂贵时，严格在策略采样是次优的。

sentences.en: Empirically, we show that a well-designed replay buffer can drastically reduce inference compute without degrading -- and in some cases even improving -- final model performance, while preserving policy entropy.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们表明精心设计的重放缓冲可以在不退化（在某些情况下甚至改善）最终模型性能的情况下大幅减少推断计算，同时保持策略熵。

title_en: Efficient Skill Grounding via Code Refactoring with Small Language Models
title_zh: 利用小语言模型进行代码重构，实现高效技能落地

sentences.en: Effective skill grounding is essential for deploying reusable skills in embodied agents, as even minor embodiment or environmental differences can render an entire skill incompatible.
sentences.zh: 有效的技能立足对于在具身智能体中部署可复用技能至关重要，因为即使是微小的具身或环境差异也可能使整个技能不兼容。

sentences.en: This challenge is particularly pronounced in embodied settings, where agents must operate in dynamic, partially observable environments without access to large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 这一挑战在具身情境中尤为突出，其中智能体必须在动态、部分可观测的环境中运作，而无法访问大语言模型（LLM）。

sentences.en: In this setting, reliance on LLMs is impractical, while small language models (sLMs) remain insufficient for the effective skill grounding required for reliable long-horizon control.
sentences.zh: 在此情境下，依赖 LLM 不切实际，而小型语言模型（sLM）对于可靠长视界控制所需的有效技能立足仍不足。

sentences.en: We present RECENT, a refactoring-centric agent framework that enables efficient skill grounding with sLMs by decoupling skill semantics from embodiment- and environment-specific execution binding.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 RECENT，一个以重构为中心的智能体框架，它通过将技能语义与具身特定和环境特定的执行绑定解耦，实现用 sLM 进行高效技能立足。

sentences.en: By representing skills as executable code, RECENT preserves the semantic intent encoded in a skill’s control structure while grounding it by modifying only execution bindings through localized refactoring, rather than regenerating code from scratch.
sentences.zh: 通过将技能表示为可执行代码，RECENT 保留了技能控制结构中编码的语义意图，同时仅通过局部化重构修改执行绑定来立足技能，而非从零重新生成代码。

sentences.en: We evaluate RECENT across diverse skill grounding scenarios spanning multiple robot embodiments in dynamic environments, demonstrating robust long-horizon performance when deployed with an sLM.
sentences.zh: 我们在横跨动态环境中多种机器人具身的多样技能立足场景中评估 RECENT，展示用 sLM 部署时的稳健长视界性能。

sentences.en: Across all scenarios, RECENT achieves the best performance among sLM-based Code-as-Policies (CaP) methods and matches the task performance of LLM-based CaP.
sentences.zh: 在所有场景中，RECENT 在基于 sLM 的代码即策略（CaP）方法中取得最佳性能，并匹配基于 LLM 的 CaP 的任务性能。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Efficient Stochastic Optimisation via Sequential Monte Carlo
title_zh: 通过序贯蒙特卡洛实现高效随机优化

sentences.en: The problem of optimising functions with intractable gradients frequently arises in machine learning and statistics, ranging from maximum marginal likelihood estimation procedures to fine-tuning of generative models.
sentences.zh: 优化具有不可处理梯度的函数的问题在机器学习与统计学中频繁出现，从极大边际似然估计程序到生成模型的微调。

sentences.en: Stochastic approximation methods for this class of problems typically require inner sampling loops to obtain (biased) stochastic gradient estimates, which rapidly becomes computationally expensive.
sentences.zh: 针对此类问题的随机逼近方法通常需要内采样回路以获得（有偏的）随机梯度估计，这迅速变得计算昂贵。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) samplers for optimisation of functions with intractable gradients.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们开发用于优化具有不可处理梯度函数的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器。

sentences.en: Our approach replaces expensive inner sampling methods with efficient SMC approximations, which can result in significant computational gains.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法用高效的 SMC 逼近取代昂贵的内采样方法，这可以带来显著计算增益。

sentences.en: We establish convergence results for the basic recursions defined by our methodology which SMC samplers approximate.
sentences.zh: 我们为我们的方法论定义的基本递归建立收敛性结果，SMC 采样器逼近这些递归。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the reward-tuning of energy-based models within various settings.
sentences.zh: 我们在各种情境中对基于能量的模型进行奖励调优，演示我们方法的有效性。

authors.name: Davide Carbone
authors.institution: Laboratoire de Physique de Ecole Normale Supérieure de Paris

title_en: Efficient Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction
title_zh: 通过潜在嵌入重建高效生成合成网络

sentences.en: Network data are ubiquitous across the social sciences, biology, and information systems.
sentences.zh: 网络数据在社会学、生物学与信息系统等领域无处不在。

sentences.en: Generating realistic synthetic network data has broad applications from network simulation to scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 生成现实的合成网络数据有从网络模拟到科学发现的广泛应用。

sentences.en: However, many existing black-box approaches for network generation tend to overfit observed data while overlooking characteristic network structure, and incur substantial computational overhead at scale.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多现有的网络生成黑盒方法倾向于过拟合观测数据，同时忽视特征性网络结构，并大规模招致可观计算开销。

sentences.en: These practical challenges call for synthetic network generation methods that are both efficient and capable of capturing structural properties of networks.
sentences.zh: 这些实际挑战要求既高效又能够捕获网络结构性质的合成网络生成方法。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction (SyNGLER), a general and efficient framework for synthetic network generation that builds on latent space network models.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入通过潜在嵌入重建的合成网络生成（SyNGLER），一个构建在潜在空间网络模型之上的通用且高效的合成网络生成框架。

sentences.en: Given an observed network, SyNGLER first learns low-dimensional latent node embeddings via a latent space network model and then reconstructs the latent space by building a distribution-free generator over these embeddings.
sentences.zh: 给定一个观测网络，SyNGLER 首先通过潜在空间网络模型学习低维潜在节点嵌入，然后通过在这些嵌入上构建无分布生成器来重建潜在空间。

sentences.en: For generation, SyNGLER first samples (or resamples) node embeddings from the generator in the latent space and then produces synthetic networks using the latent space network model.
sentences.zh: 对于生成，SyNGLER 首先在潜在空间中从生成器采样（或重采样）节点嵌入，然后使用潜在空间网络模型产生合成网络。

sentences.en: Through the latent space framework, SyNGLER preserves unique characteristics in networks such as sparsity and node degree heterogeneity, while allowing for efficient training with lower computational cost than many existing deep architectures.
sentences.zh: 通过潜在空间框架，SyNGLER 保留网络中的独特特征（如稀疏性与节点度异质性），同时允许以比许多现有深度架构更低的计算成本进行高效训练。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees by developing consistency results on the distance between the true and synthetic edge distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过建立真实与合成边分布之间距离的一致性结果提供理论保证。

sentences.en: Empirical studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of SyNGLER, which efficiently produces networks that better preserve key network characteristics such as network moments and degree distributions compared with existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 实证研究进一步展示了 SyNGLER 的有效性，它与现有方法相比，高效产生更好地保留网络矩与度分布等关键网络特征的网络。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/FeifanJiang/syngler.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/FeifanJiang/syngler 获取。

title_en: Efficient Tail-Aware Generative Optimization via Flow Model Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 通过流模型微调实现高效尾部感知生成优化

sentences.en: Fine-tuning pre-trained diffusion and flow models to optimize downstream utilities is central to real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 微调预训练扩散与流模型以优化下游效用是现实世界部署的核心。

sentences.en: Existing entropy-regularized methods primarily maximize expected reward, providing no mechanism to shape tail behavior.
sentences.zh: 现有的熵正则化方法主要最大化期望奖励，不提供塑造尾部行为的机制。

sentences.en: However, tail control is often essential: the lower tail determines reliability by limiting low-reward failures, while the upper tail enables discovery by prioritizing rare, high-reward outcomes.
sentences.zh: 然而，尾部控制常常至关重要：下尾通过限制低奖励失败决定可靠性，而上尾通过优先稀有的高奖励结果实现发现。

sentences.en: In this work, we present Tail-aware Flow Fine-Tuning (TFFT), a principled and efficient distributional fine-tuning algorithm based on the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出尾部感知流微调（TFFT），一个基于条件风险价值（CVaR）的有原则且高效的分布式微调算法。

sentences.en: We address two distinct tail-shaping goals: right-CVaR for seeking novel samples in the high-reward tail and left-CVaR for controlling worst-case samples in the low-reward tail.
sentences.zh: 我们应对两个不同的尾部塑形目标：用于在高奖励尾部寻找新颖样本的右 CVaR，与用于控制低奖励尾部最坏情况样本的左 CVaR。

sentences.en: Unlike prior approaches that rely on non-linear optimization, we leverage the variational dual formulation of CVaR to decompose it into a decoupled two-stage procedure: a lightweight one-dimensional threshold optimization step, and a single entropy-regularized fine-tuning process via a specific pseudo-reward.
sentences.zh: 与依赖非线性优化的先前方法不同，我们利用 CVaR 的变分对偶表述，将其分解为解耦的两阶段过程：一个轻量级一维阈值优化步骤，以及一个通过特定伪奖励的单个熵正则化微调过程。

sentences.en: This decomposition achieves CVaR fine-tuning efficiently with computational cost comparable to standard expected fine-tuning methods.
sentences.zh: 这种分解以与标准期望微调方法相当的计算成本实现高效的 CVaR 微调。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of TFFT across illustrative experiments, high-dimensional text-to-image generation, and molecular design.
sentences.zh: 我们在说明性实验、高维文生图与分子设计中展示 TFFT 的有效性。

title_en: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models with OCL Search
title_zh: 利用 OCL 搜索高效开展生成式规划模型的测试时推理

sentences.en: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution.
sentences.zh: 生成模型已成为 AI 规划的强大范式，然而其性能仍受训练数据分布的约束。

sentences.en: One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute.
sentences.zh: 一种方法是通过扩展测试时计算来改善推断期间生成的解。

sentences.en: A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself.
sentences.zh: 一种更高效的替代方案是优化推断过程本身。

sentences.en: In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们表明经典开放-闭合列表（OCL）搜索的一个修改版本恰好提供这样一种高效推断过程。

sentences.en: Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法协同两个学习组件：一个从中间状态执行快速 rollout 的生成模型，与一个在候选推理路径之间排序的启发式模型。

sentences.en: Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework.
sentences.zh: 关键贡献包括新颖的探索控制机制以及学习模型在 OCL 框架内的整合。

sentences.en: Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.
sentences.zh: 在多个组合规划领域中，我们的方法在计算效率与解质量上超越神经符号搜索基线与经典求解器。

title_en: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 通过分层搜索与自验证实现离散扩散语言模型高效测试时扩展

sentences.en: Inference-time compute has re-emerged as a practical way to improve LLM reasoning.
sentences.zh: 推理时计算已重新出现为改善 LLM 推理的实用方式。

sentences.en: Most test-time scaling (TTS) algorithms rely on autoregressive decoding, which is ill-suited to discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) due to their parallel decoding over the entire sequence.
sentences.zh: 大多数测试时扩展（TTS）算法依赖自回归解码，这因离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）对整个序列的并行解码而不适合它们。

sentences.en: As a result, developing effective and efficient TTS methods to unlock dLLMs' full generative potential remains an underexplored challenge.
sentences.zh: 因此，开发有效且高效的 TTS 方法以释放 dLLM 的全部生成潜力仍是一个未充分探索的挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose \textbf{LLaDA-S}, an efficient TTS framework for dLLMs that (i) performs \textbf{Hierarchical Trajectory Search} (HTS) which dynamically prunes and reallocates compute in an early-to-mid denoising window, (ii) replaces external verifiers with \textbf{Self-Verified Feedback} (SVF) obtained via self-evaluation prompts on intermediate completions, and (iii) introduces \textbf{Local branching with partial remasking} to explore diverse implementations while preserving a high-confidence tokens.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 \textbf{LLaDA-S}，一个用于 dLLM 的高效 TTS 框架，它（i）执行\textbf{Hierarchical Trajectory Search}（HTS），在早到中去噪窗口动态剪枝并重新分配计算，（ii）用通过对中间完成进行自我评估提示获得的\textbf{Self-Verified Feedback}（SVF）取代外部验证器，并且（iii）引入\textbf{Local branching with partial remasking}，以探索多样实现同时保留高置信词元。

sentences.en: Across four mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on three dLLMs, including LLaDA 8B Instruct, Dream 7B Instruct, and LLaDA 2.0-mini, our LLaDA-S achieves a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off, matching best-of-$N$ performance with substantially fewer function evaluations (NFE).
sentences.zh: 在三个 dLLM 上（包括 LLaDA 8B Instruct、Dream 7B Instruct 与 LLaDA 2.0-mini）的四个数学推理与代码生成基准上，我们的 LLaDA-S 实现有利的性能-效率权衡，以显著更少的函数评估（NFE）匹敌 best-of-N 性能。

sentences.en: The code will be released.
sentences.zh: 代码将发布。

authors.name: Ming-Hsuan Yang
authors.institution: Google DeepMind; University of California at Merced

title_en: Efficient Training of Boltzmann Generators Using Off-Policy Log-Dispersion Regularization
title_zh: 利用离策略对数离散度正则化高效训练玻尔兹曼生成器

sentences.en: Sampling from unnormalized probability densities is a central challenge in computational science.
sentences.zh: 从未归一化概率密度采样是计算科学中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Boltzmann generators are generative models that enable independent sampling from the Boltzmann distribution of physical systems at a given temperature.
sentences.zh: Boltzmann 生成器是支持在给定温度下从物理系统的 Boltzmann 分布独立采样的生成模型。

sentences.en: However, their practical success depends on data-efficient training, as both simulation data and target energy evaluations are costly.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的实际成功取决于数据高效训练，因为模拟数据与目标能量评估都昂贵。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose off-policy log-dispersion regularization (LDR), a novel regularization framework that builds on a generalization of the log-variance objective.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出离策略对数离散正则化（LDR），一个基于对数方差目标推广的新正则化框架。

sentences.en: We apply LDR in the off-policy setting in combination with standard data-based training objectives, without requiring additional on-policy samples.
sentences.zh: 我们在离策略情境中将 LDR 与标准基于数据的训练目标结合使用，而无需额外在策略样本。

sentences.en: LDR acts as a shape regularizer of the energy landscape by leveraging additional information in the form of target energy labels.
sentences.zh: LDR 通过利用目标能量标签形式的附加信息，充当能量景观的形状正则化器。

sentences.en: The proposed regularization framework is broadly applicable, supporting unbiased or biased simulation datasets as well as purely variational training without access to target samples.
sentences.zh: 所提出的正则化框架广泛适用，支持无偏或有偏模拟数据集，以及无法访问目标样本的纯变分训练。

sentences.en: Across all benchmarks, LDR improves both final performance and data efficiency, with sample efficiency gains of up to one order of magnitude.
sentences.zh: 跨所有基准，LDR 改善最终性能与数据效率，样本效率增益至多一个数量级。

authors.name: Henrik Schopmans
authors.institution: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), Institute for Anthropomatics and Robotics (IAR)

title_en: Efficient Training-Free Multi-Token Prediction via Embedding-Space Probing
title_zh: 通过嵌入空间探查实现高效、无需训练的多词元预测

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess latent multi-token prediction (MTP) abilities despite being trained only for next-token generation.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）即使仅针对下一词元生成训练，也拥有潜在的多词元预测（MTP）能力。

sentences.en: We introduce ESP (Embedding-Space Probing), a simple and training-free MTP method that probes an LLM using on-the-fly mask tokens drawn from its embedding space, enabling parallel future-token prediction without modifying weights or relying on draft models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ESP（嵌入空间探针），一种简单且免训练的 MTP 方法，它使用从其嵌入空间抽取的即时掩码词元探询 LLM，从而无需修改权重或依赖草稿模型即可实现并行未来词元预测。

sentences.en: ESP constructs a speculative token tree by sampling Top-K candidates from mask-token logits and applies a lightweight pruning rule to retain high-probability continuations.
sentences.zh: ESP 通过从掩码词元 logits 采样 Top-K 候选构造投机词元树，并应用轻量级剪枝规则保留高概率续写。

sentences.en: During generation, predictions are verified in parallel, yielding lossless decoding while significantly reducing model calls and increasing token throughput.
sentences.zh: 在生成期间，预测被并行验证，实现无损解码，同时显著减少模型调用并提高词元吞吐量。

sentences.en: ESP consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines, improving acceptance length by $7$–$11$% over Lookahead Decoding on LLaMA3 and $7$–$8$% on Qwen3, and increasing throughput by up to $15$–$19$% over the strongest baseline.
sentences.zh: ESP 一致超越现有免训练基线，在 LLaMA3 上接受长度相对前瞻解码提升 7-11%，在 Qwen3 上提升 7-8%，并将吞吐量相对最强基线提升至多 15-19%。

sentences.en: Finally, we provide theoretical insight and empirical evidence showing that decoder layers naturally align mask-token representations with next-token states, enabling accurate multi-step prediction without retraining or auxiliary models.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提供理论洞见与实证证据，表明解码器层天然将掩码词元表示与下一词元状态对齐，从而无需重训或辅助模型即可实现准确多步预测。

title_en: Efficient Transformer Attention for SNNs via Hadamard Simplification
title_zh: 通过 Hadamard 简化实现脉冲神经网络的高效 Transformer 注意力

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable low-power, event-driven computation, but Transformer-based SNNs remain difficult to deploy on neuromorphic hardware due to dense operations and communication overhead.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）支持低功耗、事件驱动计算，但基于 Transformer 的 SNN 因密集运算与通信开销而仍难以在神经形态硬件上部署。

sentences.en: We propose two simplified attention mechanisms, \textbf{Simplified Spiking Attention (SSA)} and \textbf{Ultra-Simplified Spiking Attention (USSA)}, which replace matrix multiplication with Hadamard products and eliminate hardware-unfriendly components such as multi-head attention and scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出两种简化注意力机制，\textbf{Simplified Spiking Attention (SSA)}与\textbf{Ultra-Simplified Spiking Attention (USSA)}，它们用 Hadamard 积取代矩阵乘法，并消除多头注意力与缩放等硬件不友好组件。

sentences.en: We show that consecutive masking is redundant and analyze a spiking-order effect in which early spiking contributes more temporal information to attention modulation.
sentences.zh: 我们表明连续掩码是冗余的，并分析一种脉冲顺序效应，其中早期脉冲为注意力调制贡献更多时间信息。

sentences.en: On CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and DVS-Gesture, SSA achieves accuracies of 96.38\%, 79.45\%, and 97.56\%, respectively, while reducing computational complexity from $\mathcal{O}(N^2D)$ to $\mathcal{O}(ND)$ and communication complexity from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(ND)$.
sentences.zh: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 DVS-Gesture 上，SSA 分别实现 96.38%、79.45% 与 97.56% 的准确率，同时将计算复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(N^2D)$ 降到 $\mathcal{O}(ND)$，通信复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ 降到 $\mathcal{O}(ND)$。

sentences.en: USSA further reduces communication complexity to $\mathcal{O}(N)$ with only marginal accuracy degradation.
sentences.zh: USSA 进一步将通信复杂度降到 $\mathcal{O}(N)$，且准确率退化可忽略。

sentences.en: On ImageNet-1K, SSA and USSA achieve 76.91\% and 77.27\% accuracy, respectively, demonstrating scalability to large-scale classification.
sentences.zh: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，SSA 与 USSA 分别实现 76.91% 与 77.27% 的准确率，展示了对大规模分类的可扩展性。

title_en: Efficient, Property-Aligned Fan-Out Retrieval via RL-Compiled Diffusion
title_zh: 通过强化学习编译的扩散实现高效、属性对齐的扇出检索

sentences.en: Many modern retrieval problems are set-valued: given a broad intent, the system must return a collection of results that optimizes higherorder properties (e.g., diversity, coverage, complementarity, coherence) while staying grounded to a fixed database.
sentences.zh: 许多现代检索问题是集合值的：给定一个宽泛意图，系统必须返回一个优化高阶性质（例如多样性、覆盖率、互补性、连贯性）的结果集合，同时立足于固定数据库。

sentences.en: Set-valued objectives are inherently non-decomposable and are not captured by existing supervised (query, content) datasets which only prioritize top-1 retrieval.
sentences.zh: 集合值目标固有地不可分解，并且不被仅优先 top-1 检索的现有监督（查询、内容）数据集捕获。

sentences.en: While reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize set-level objectives via interaction, deploying an RL-tuned LLM for fan-out retrieval is prohibitively expensive at query time.
sentences.zh: 虽然强化学习（RL）可以通过交互优化集合级目标，但在查询时部署 RL 调优的 LLM 进行扇出检索成本过高。

sentences.en: Conversely, diffusion-based generative retrieval enables efficient single-pass fan-out in embedding space, but requires objective-aligned training targets.
sentences.zh: 相反，基于扩散的生成式检索可以在嵌入空间中实现高效单次扇出，但需要目标对齐的训练目标。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose R4T (Retrieve-for-Train), which uses RL once as an objective transducer in a three step process: (i) train a fan-out LLM with composite set-level rewards, (ii) synthesize objective-consistent training pairs, and (iii) train a lightweight diffusion retriever to model the conditional distribution of set-valued outputs.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 R4T（为训练检索），它在一个三步过程中将 RL 用作一次目标传感器：（i）用复合集合级奖励训练一个扇出 LLM，（ii）综合目标一致的训练对，以及（iii）训练一个轻量级扩散检索器，对集合值输出的条件分布建模。

sentences.en: Across Polyvore and a music playlist dataset, R4T improves retrieval quality over strong baselines while reducing query-time fan-out latency by an order of magnitude.
sentences.zh: 在 Polyvore 与音乐播放列表数据集上，R4T 在降低查询时扇出延迟一个数量级的同时，改善强基线上的检索质量。

title_en: Efficient, Validation-Free Intrinsic Quality Estimation for Large-Scale Face Recognition Datasets
title_zh: 大规模人脸识别数据集的高效、无需验证的内在质量估计

sentences.en: We propose Intrinsic Quality (IQ), a validation-free metric designed to estimate the inherent potential of face recognition (FR) datasets to produce high-performance models without the need for full-scale training.
sentences.zh: 我们提出内在质量（IQ），一个免验证指标，旨在估算人脸识别（FR）数据集产生高性能模型的固有能力，而无需全规模训练。

sentences.en: IQ integrates two components: (i) a Neighbor-Consistency Score that quantifies local identity label agreement via nearest neighbors, and (ii) Global Representation Subspace Complexity (Effective Rank, ER), which captures the underlying embedding geometry and dataset diversity.
sentences.zh: IQ 整合两个组件：（i）通过最近邻量化局部身份标签一致性的邻居一致性分数，以及（ii）捕获底层嵌入几何与数据集多样性的全局表示子空间复杂度（有效秩，ER）。

sentences.en: IQ allows for rapid evaluation using lightweight proxy models or data subsets, facilitating dataset diagnosis and curation prior to resource-intensive full-scale training.
sentences.zh: IQ 支持使用轻量级代理模型或数据子集进行快速评估，促进在资源密集型全规模训练之前的数据集诊断与策展。

sentences.en: We describe an experimental protocol tailored to clean, noisy, and mixed‑quality FR datasets, and outline evaluation methodologies to validate IQ’s predictive power for downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 我们描述一个针对干净、含噪与混合质量 FR 数据集量身定制的实验协议，并概述评估方法以验证 IQ 对下游性能的预测力。

authors.name: Meng Yang
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Efficient-DLM: From Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models, and Beyond in Speed
title_zh: Efficient-DLM：从自回归到扩散语言模型，并进一步突破速度限制

sentences.en: Diffusion language models (dLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm enabling parallel generation, but their learning efficiency lags behind that of autoregressive (AR) language models when trained from scratch.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（dLM）已成为一个支持并行生成的有前景范式，但它们在从零训练时学习效率落后于自回归（AR）语言模型。

sentences.en: To this end, we study AR-to-dLM conversion, which transforms pretrained AR models into efficient dLMs that excel in speed while preserving AR models’ task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们研究 AR 到 dLM 的转换，它将预训练 AR 模型转换为在速度上出色、同时保持 AR 模型任务准确率的高效 dLM。

sentences.en: We achieve this by identifying limitations in the attention patterns and objectives of existing AR-to-dLM methods and then proposing methodologies and actionable insights for scalable AR-to-dLM conversion.
sentences.zh: 我们通过识别现有 AR 到 dLM 方法在注意力模式与目标上的局限，然后提出用于可扩展 AR 到 dLM 转换的方法论与可操作洞见来实现这一点。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first systematically compare different attention patterns and find that maintaining pretrained AR weight distributions is key to effective AR-to-dLM conversion.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先系统比较不同注意力模式，发现保持预训练 AR 权重分布是有效 AR 到 dLM 转换的关键。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we introduce a continuous pretraining scheme with a block-wise attention pattern.
sentences.zh: 据此，我们引入一个带块状注意力模式的连续预训练方案。

sentences.en: We find that, in addition to block-wise attention’s known benefit of enabling KV caching, its block-wise causality better preserves pretrained AR models’ weight distributions, leading to a win–win in accuracy and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，除了块状注意力已知的启用 KV 缓存好处之外，其块状因果性更好地保留预训练 AR 模型的权重分布，从而在准确率与效率上实现双赢。

sentences.en: Second, to mitigate the training–test gap in mask token distributions (uniform vs. highly left-to-right), we propose a position-dependent token masking strategy that assigns higher masking probabilities to later tokens during training to better mimic test-time behavior.
sentences.zh: 其次，为缓解掩码词元分布（均匀 vs. 高度从左到右）中的训练-测试差距，我们提出一个位置相关词元掩码策略，它在训练期间为较后词元分配更高掩码概率，以更好地模拟测试时行为。

sentences.en: These studies lead to the Efficient-DLM model family, which outperforms state-of-the-art AR models and dLMs in accuracy–throughput trade-offs; for example, our Efficient-DLM-8B achieves +5.4\%/+2.7\% higher accuracy with 4.7$\times$/2.8$\times$ higher throughput compared to Dream-7B and Qwen3-4B, respectively.
sentences.zh: 这些研究产生 Efficient-DLM 模型家族，它在准确率-吞吐量权衡上超越最先进的 AR 模型与 dLM；例如，我们的 Efficient-DLM-8B 相对 Dream-7B 与 Qwen3-4B 分别实现 +5.4\%/+2.7\% 的更高准确率与 4.7$\times$/2.8$\times$ 的更高吞吐量。

title_en: Efficiently Learning Drifting Halfspaces with Massart Noise
title_zh: 高效学习带有 Massart 噪声的漂移半空间

sentences.en: We study the problem of learning a drifting concept in the  presence of Massart noise.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在 Massart 噪声存在下学习漂移概念的问题。

sentences.en: In this framework,  an online learner has access to a history  of independent samples whose labels are noisy versions  of a target concept that may change from round to round.
sentences.zh: 在此框架中，在线学习器可以访问独立样本的历史，这些样本的标签是可能逐轮变化的目标概念的含噪版本。

sentences.en: The goal is to output, in each round, a hypothesis with  small prediction error.
sentences.zh: 目标是每轮输出一个预测误差小的假设。

sentences.en: We study the complexity of this learning  problem for the fundamental class of margin-separable  linear classifiers (halfspaces).
sentences.zh: 我们研究这一学习问题对间隔可分线性分类器（半空间）这一基本类别的复杂度。

sentences.en: On the positive side, we give a  computationally efficient learner achieving error  $\eta + \tilde O(\Delta^{1/3}/\gamma)$,  where $\eta$ upper bounds the Massart noise rate,  $\Delta$ is the drift rate, and $\gamma$ is the margin.
sentences.zh: 在积极方面，我们给出一个计算高效的学习器，实现误差 $\eta + \tilde O(\Delta^{1/3}/\gamma)$，其中 eta 上界 Massart 噪声率，Delta 是漂移率，gamma 是间隔。

sentences.en: Interestingly, in the realizable setting,  an  adaptation of our techniques  yields an efficient learner with an improved error  rate over prior work.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在可实现情境中，我们技术的适配产生一个相对先前工作错误率改善的高效学习器。

sentences.en: On the lower-bound side, we provide formal evidence of an  information-computation tradeoff, strongly suggesting that  our algorithm's performance is essentially optimal.
sentences.zh: 在下界方面，我们提供信息-计算权衡的形式化证据，强烈表明我们算法的性能本质上最优。

sentences.en: Specifically,  while the information-theoretically optimal error  scales with $\Delta^{1/2}$, we prove  that $\Delta^{1/3}$-scaling is unavoidable for  low-degree polynomial tests,  even in the special case of random classification noise.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，虽然信息论最优误差随 $\Delta^{1/2}$ 扩展，我们证明即使是在随机分类噪声这一特殊情形下，低次多项式检验的 $\Delta^{1/3}$ 扩展也是不可避免的。

authors.name: Guyang Cao
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Wisconsin - Madison

title_en: Efficiently Solving Discounted MDPs via Predictions with Unknown Prediction Errors
title_zh: 在预测误差未知时利用预测高效求解折扣马尔可夫决策过程

sentences.en: We study infinite-horizon discounted Markov decision processes (DMDPs) under a generative model.
sentences.zh: 我们研究生成模型下的无限时域折扣马尔可夫决策过程（DMDP）。

sentences.en: Motivated by the Algorithms with Advice framework (Mitzenmacher and Vassilvitskii, 2022), we propose a novel framework to investigate how black-box predictions of the transition matrix can enhance sample efficiency in solving DMDPs and improve sample complexity bounds.
sentences.zh: 受带建议算法框架（Mitzenmacher 与 Vassilvitskii，2022）的激励，我们提出一个新框架，研究转迁矩阵的黑盒预测如何增强求解 DMDP 的样本效率并改善样本复杂度界。

sentences.en: We focus on DMDPs with $N$ state–action pairs and discount factor $\gamma$.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于带 N 个状态-动作对与折扣因子 gamma 的 DMDP。

sentences.en: We first provide an impossibility result showing that, in the presence of predictions with unknown accuracy, no sampling policy can compute an $\epsilon$-optimal policy with a sample complexity better than $\tilde{O}((1-\gamma)^{-3} N \epsilon^{-2})$, which matches the state-of-the-art minimax sample complexity bound without prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提供一个不可能性结果，表明在预测准确性未知的情况下，任何采样策略都不能以优于 O~((1-gamma)^-3 N epsilon^-2) 的样本复杂度计算 epsilon 最优策略，这与无预测的最先进极小极大样本复杂度界匹配。

sentences.en: In complement, we design an algorithm based on minimax optimization techniques that leverages predictions of the transition matrix without requiring knowledge of the prediction error.
sentences.zh: 作为补充，我们设计一个基于极小极大优化技术的算法，它在无需知道预测误差的情况下利用转迁矩阵的预测。

sentences.en: Our algorithm achieves a sample complexity bound that depends on the prediction error and is uniformly better than $\tilde{O}((1-\gamma)^{-4} N \epsilon^{-2})$, the previous best result derived from convex optimization methods.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法实现一个依赖于预测误差的样本复杂度界，并一致优于由凸优化方法推导的先前最佳结果 O~((1-gamma)^-4 N epsilon^-2)。

sentences.en: In some cases, our bound even improves upon the state-of-the-art $\tilde{O}((1-\gamma)^{-3} N \epsilon^{-2})$, despite not having access to the prediction quality.
sentences.zh: 在某些情形下，尽管无法访问预测质量，我们的界甚至改进了最先进的 O~((1-gamma)^-3 N epsilon^-2)。

title_en: Efficiently Training Time-to-First-Spike Spiking Neural Networks from Scratch
title_zh: 从零开始高效训练首次脉冲时间编码的脉冲神经网络

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), with their event-driven and biologically inspired mechanisms, are well-suited for energy-efficient neuromorphic hardware.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）凭借其事件驱动且受生物启发的机制，非常适合能效神经形态硬件。

sentences.en: Neural coding, which is critical to SNNs, determines how information is represented via spikes.
sentences.zh: 对 SNN 至关重要的神经编码，决定信息如何通过脉冲表示。

sentences.en: While Time-to-First-Spike (TTFS) coding uses a single spike per neuron to offer extreme sparsity and energy efficiency, it often suffers from unstable training and low accuracy due to its sparse firing.
sentences.zh: 虽然首脉冲时间（TTFS）编码对每个神经元使用单个脉冲，提供极致稀疏性与能效，但它常常因稀疏发射而遭受不稳定训练与低准确率。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a training framework that incorporates parameter initialization, training normalization, a temporal output decoder, and a re-evaluation of the pooling layer.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出一个整合参数初始化、训练归一化、时域输出解码器与池化层重新评估的训练框架。

sentences.en: The proposed parameter initialization and training normalization mitigate signal diminishing and gradient vanishing, which helps stabilize training.
sentences.zh: 所提出的参数初始化与训练归一化缓解信号减弱与梯度消失，有助于稳定训练。

sentences.en: Our output decoder aggregates temporal spikes to encourage earlier firing, thereby reducing latency.
sentences.zh: 我们的输出解码器聚合时间脉冲以鼓励更早发射，从而减少延迟。

sentences.en: The re-evaluation of the pooling layer demonstrates that max-pooling violates single-spike constraints, which should be avoided, whereas average-pooling preserves them.
sentences.zh: 池化层的重新评估表明，最大池化违反单脉冲约束（应被避免），而平均池化保留它们。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our framework stabilizes and accelerates training, reduces latency, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy for step-by-step TTFS SNNs on MNIST ($99.48\%$), Fashion-MNIST ($92.90\%$), CIFAR10 ($90.56\%$), CIFAR100 ($70.27\%$) and DVS Gesture ($95.83\%$).
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的框架稳定并加速训练、减少延迟，并在逐步 TTFS SNN 上对 MNIST（99.48%）、Fashion-MNIST（92.90%）、CIFAR10（90.56%）、CIFAR100（70.27%）与 DVS Gesture（95.83%）实现最先进准确率。

authors.name: Peng Xue
authors.institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: EGG: An Expert-Guided Agent Framework for Kernel Generation
title_zh: EGG：用于内核生成的专家引导智能体框架

sentences.en: High-performance GPU kernels are critical for reducing the exponentially growing computational costs of large language models (LLMs), but their development heavily relies on manual tuning by domain experts.
sentences.zh: 高性能 GPU 内核对于降低大语言模型（LLM）指数增长的计算成本至关重要，但它们的开发严重依赖领域专家的手动调优。

sentences.en: While recent advances in LLM-based approaches show promise for automating kernel generation, they still struggle to achieve both correctness and high performance.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于 LLM 方法的近期进展在自动化内核生成方面展现出前景，但它们仍难以同时实现正确性与高性能。

sentences.en: This limitation primarily arises from the lack of domain-specific optimization guidance, hindering effective exploration of the optimization space.
sentences.zh: 这一局限主要源于缺乏领域特定优化指导，阻碍了对优化空间的有效探索。

sentences.en: We propose $\textbf{EGG}$, an $\underline{E}$xpert-$\underline{G}$uided Agent Framework for Kernel $\underline{G}$eneration, which incorporates expert optimization principles to guide LLMs’ decisions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \textbf{EGG}，一个用于内核生成的专家引导智能体框架，它纳入专家优化原则来引导 LLM 的决策。

sentences.en: Inspired by expert workflows, we decompose kernel generation into two hierarchical stages: 1) algorithmic structure design, which establishes a high-quality computational structure foundation;
sentences.zh: 受专家工作流启发，我们将内核生成分解为两个层级阶段：1）算法结构设计，建立高质量的计算结构基础；

sentences.en: 2) hardware-specific tuning, which performs targeted adjustments through parallel mapping, tensor tiling, and memory optimization.
sentences.zh: 2）硬件特定调优，通过并行映射、张量平铺与内存优化执行针对性调整。

sentences.en: This staged decomposition defines explicit optimization objectives, structuring the design space to achieve progressive refinements.
sentences.zh: 这种分阶段分解定义显式优化目标，结构化设计空间以实现渐进精炼。

sentences.en: To this end, a stage-aware multi-agent collaboration mechanism is designed for inter and intra-stage context management, ensuring stable optimization trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为此，设计一个阶段感知的多智能体协作机制，用于阶段间与阶段内上下文管理，确保稳定优化轨迹。

sentences.en: Experiments on KernelBench and real-world workloads show that EGG achieves a $2.13\times$ average speedup over PyTorch, outperforming existing agent-based and RL-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 在 KernelBench 与实际工作负载上的实验表明，EGG 相对 PyTorch 实现 2.13\times 的平均加速，超越现有的基于智能体与基于 RL 的方法。

title_en: Ego3S: Select, Strengthen, and Synchronize for Efficient Egocentric Reasoning
title_zh: Ego3S：通过选择、强化与同步实现高效第一视角推理

sentences.en: Egocentric reasoning fundamentally differs from third-person understanding in LVLMs.
sentences.zh: 自我中心推理与 LVLM 中的第三人称理解有根本不同。

sentences.en: Third-person settings offer wide and stable contexts with consistent global regularities, allowing models to utilize broad statistical correlations.
sentences.zh: 第三人称情境提供宽且稳定的上下文与一致的全局规律，使模型能够利用广泛的统计相关。

sentences.en: In contrast, egocentric scenes are highly dynamic and heterogeneous, where decisive cues are localized and atypical.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，自我中心场景高度动态且异构，其中决定性线索是局部化且非典型的。

sentences.en: Therefore, robust egocentric reasoning requires models to focus on ''what is seen now'', i.e., the immediate visual input.
sentences.zh: 因此，稳健的自我中心推理要求模型聚焦“现在看到的”，即即时视觉输入。

sentences.en: However, existing methods tend to exhibit "inertial thinking'', relying excessively on language priors and global context.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法倾向于表现出“惯性思维”，过度依赖语言先验与全局上下文。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose a novel three-stage Ego3S framework to ground models' reasoning in interaction evidence.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出一个新颖的三阶段 Ego3S 框架，将模型的推理立足于交互证据。

sentences.en: Specifically, before training, we first utilize the counterfactual-based paradigm to select high-value samples that effectively activate multimodal reasoning, thus mitigating the over-reliance on language priors and global context.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在训练之前，我们首先利用基于反事实的范式选择能有效激活多模态推理的高价值样本，从而缓解对语言先验与全局上下文的过度依赖。

sentences.en: Moreover, we introduce an interaction-centric reward for reinforcement learning that strengthens the model’s sensitivity to localized interaction cues.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为强化学习引入一个以交互为中心的奖励，加强模型对局部化交互线索的敏感性。

sentences.en: Finally, during training, we employ a variance-aware learning schedule that monitors reward distributions to dynamically synchronize data selection with the evolving model competence.
sentences.zh: 最后，在训练期间，我们采用方差感知学习调度，监控奖励分布以动态地将数据选择与演化中的模型能力同步。

sentences.en: Experiments on five datasets show that our Ego3S consistently achieves superior performance using only 26.5% of the training data, while reducing computational costs by over 46%.
sentences.zh: 在五个数据集上的实验表明，我们的 Ego3S 仅用 26.5% 的训练数据就一致实现卓越性能，同时将计算成本降低超过 46%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Mrshenshen/Ego3S.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Mrshenshen/Ego3S 获取。

title_en: EgoTactile: Learning Grasp Pressure for Everyday Objects from Egocentric Video
title_zh: EgoTactile：从第一视角视频中学习日常物体的抓取压力

sentences.en: Estimating full-hand grasp pressure from egocentric video is critical for immersive VR and robotic manipulation, yet dense tactile sensing often relies on intrusive hardware.
sentences.zh: 从自我中心视频估计全手抓握压力，对于沉浸式 VR 与机器人操作至关重要，然而稠密触觉传感常常依赖侵入性硬件。

sentences.en: Existing vision-based methods predominantly rely on planar surfaces or fingertip contacts, failing to generalize to complex 3D object interactions.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于视觉的方法主要依赖平面表面或指尖接触，无法泛化到复杂 3D 物体交互。

sentences.en: Therefore, we introduce EgoTactile, a benchmark pairing egocentric video with full-hand pressure supervision for diverse everyday objects, incorporating a bare-hand transfer subset to enable generalization to natural scenarios.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入 EgoTactile，一个将自我中心视频与多样日常物体的全手压力监督配对的基准，并入一个裸手迁移子集以实现对自然场景的泛化。

sentences.en: Leveraging this benchmark, we first establish EgoPressureFormer as a discriminative baseline.
sentences.zh: 利用这一基准，我们首先建立 EgoPressureFormer 作为判别性基线。

sentences.en: Beyond this, to explicitly address the uncertainty in partial observations, we propose EgoPressureDiff, a conditional diffusion framework that adapts a large-scale pre-trained video diffusion backbone.
sentences.zh: 在此之外，为显式应对部分观测中的不确定性，我们提出 EgoPressureDiff，一个适配大规模预训练视频扩散主干的条件下扩散框架。

sentences.en: By combining rich world knowledge priors with a Physically-Informed Feature Rectification layer to inject semantic constraints, our approach effectively hallucinates plausible contact patterns and resolves visual-physical ambiguities.
sentences.zh: 通过将丰富的世界知识先验与物理知情特征校正层结合以注入语义约束，我们的方法有效幻觉出貌似合理的接触模式并解决视觉-物理模糊性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance on the benchmark and robust transferability to in-the-wild scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在该基准上实现优越性能，并在自然场景中表现出稳健迁移性。

sentences.en: Our project page is at https://egotactile.github.io/.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面位于 https://egotactile.github.io/。

title_en: EigenCache: Rethinking Diffusion Acceleration as Covariance-Optimal Forecasting and Submodular Information Allocation
title_zh: EigenCache：将扩散加速重新视为协方差最优预测与次模信息分配

sentences.en: Accelerating diffusion models via feature caching has progressed from static feature reuse to polynomial extrapolation, yet current cache-then-forecast strategies still rely on hand-crafted approximation families (e.g., Taylor or Hermite bases) that can misalign with the non-stationary, layer-specific dynamics of generative features.
sentences.zh: 通过特征缓存加速扩散模型已从静态特征复用进展到多项式外推，然而当前的先缓存后预测策略仍依赖可能错位的、手工构造的逼近族（例如 Taylor 或 Hermite 基），与生成特征的非平稳、逐层动态不符。

sentences.en: This paper introduces EigenCache, a training-free framework that re-frames diffusion acceleration as covariance-adaptive feature forecasting and uncertainty-aware temporal design.
sentences.zh: 本文引入 EigenCache，一个免训练框架，它将扩散加速重新框定为协方差自适应特征预测与不确定性感知的时间设计。

sentences.en: EigenCache models cached feature trajectories as time-indexed stochastic processes and estimates layer-wise temporal kernels from a small calibration set.
sentences.zh: EigenCache 将缓存特征轨迹建模为时间索引随机过程，并从小型校准集估计逐层时间核。

sentences.en: Under the resulting scalar temporal-kernel approximation, the Gaussian-process posterior mean, i.e., Kriging, is risk-optimal within the scalar-weighted linear predictor class; under joint Gaussianity, it further coincides with the MMSE estimator.
sentences.zh: 在所得的标量时间核逼近下，高斯过程后验均值（即 Kriging）在标量加权线性预测器类内是风险最优的；在联合高斯条件下，它进一步与 MMSE 估计器重合。

sentences.en: This formulation generalizes fixed-basis forecasting from a covariance-adaptive perspective while providing a closed-form posterior-variance proxy for prediction uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 这一表述从协方差自适应视角推广了固定基预测，同时提供预测不确定性的闭式后验方差代理。

sentences.en: Leveraging this proxy, EigenCache selects computation anchors by maximizing a log-determinant information-gain objective over denoising timesteps, a monotone submodular objective with a near-optimal greedy solution.
sentences.zh: 利用这一代理，EigenCache 通过在去噪时间步上最大化 log-行列式信息增益目标选择计算锚点，这是一个具有近最优贪心解的单调子模目标。

sentences.en: Across image, video, transformer, U-Net, and LoRA-adapted diffusion models, EigenCache achieves a strong speed--fidelity Pareto frontier and provides a principled mechanism for robust compute allocation.
sentences.zh: 在图像、视频、Transformer、U-Net 与 LoRA 适配扩散模型上，EigenCache 实现强速度-保真度 Pareto 前沿，并为稳健计算分配提供有原则的机制。

title_en: Eigenvectors of Experts are Training-free Non-collapsing Routers
title_zh: 专家特征向量是无需训练且不会坍缩的路由器

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) architectures improve the training efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) by routing input tokens to a selected subset of specialized experts.
sentences.zh: 稀疏混合专家（SMoE）架构通过将输入词元路由到所选的特化专家子集，改善大语言模型（LLM）的训练效率。

sentences.en: Despite their remarkable success, both training and inference in SMoE models suffer from the *expert collapse* issue (Chi et al., 2022a), which degrades model performance.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得显著成功，SMoE 模型的训练与推断都遭受*专家坍缩*问题（Chi 等人，2022a），这会降低模型性能。

sentences.en: Prior studies primarily focus on improving the router; however, such methods rely on training from scratch or fine-tuning, which requires high computational and data-processing costs.
sentences.zh: 先前研究主要聚焦于改进路由器；然而，此类方法依赖从零训练或微调，需要高计算与数据处理成本。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate that, despite these efforts, the issue persists when advancing well-pretrained SMoE models, as evidenced by both theoretical and empirical results.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过理论与实证结果表明，尽管作了这些努力，当推进预训练良好的 SMoE 模型时该问题仍然存在。

sentences.en: To fill that gap, we analyze the advanced SMoE models and observe that the eigenvectors of expert weight matrices encode rich semantic information, pointing to an effective alternative to conventional routing strategies.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们分析先进的 SMoE 模型，并观察到专家权重矩阵的特征向量编码丰富的语义信息，指出常规路由策略的有效替代方案。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose **Singular Value Decomposition SMoE (SSMoE)**, a novel and *training-free* framework that leverages spectral properties of the expert weights to address the collapse issue and enhance model performance.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 **奇异值分解 SMoE（SSMoE）**，一个利用专家权重谱性质应对坍缩问题并增强模型性能的新颖*免训练*框架。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse language and vision tasks, under both clean and corrupt data settings, demonstrate the strong generalization and robustness of SSMoE. Our findings highlight how a deeper understanding of model internals can guide the development of more effective SMoE architectures.
sentences.zh: 跨多样语言与视觉任务、在干净与损坏数据情境下的大量实验，展示了 SSMoE 的强泛化与稳健性。我们的发现凸显对模型内部更深入的理解如何能指导更有效 SMoE 架构的开发。

title_en: Ekka: Automated Diagnosis of Silent Errors in LLM Inference
title_zh: Ekka：自动诊断大语言模型推理中的静默错误

sentences.en: LLM serving frameworks are quickly evolving with a complex software stack and a vast number of optimizations.
sentences.zh: LLM 服务框架正随着复杂软件栈与大量优化而快速演化。

sentences.en: The rapid development process can introduce silent errors where output quality silently degrades without any explicit error signals.
sentences.zh: 快速的开发过程可能引入静默错误，其中输出质量在没有任何显式错误信号的情况下悄然退化。

sentences.en: Diagnosing silent errors is notoriously difficult due to the substantial semantic gap between the high-level symptoms and the low-level root causes.
sentences.zh: 由于高层症状与低层根本原因之间存在巨大语义差距，诊断静默错误以恶名著称地困难。

sentences.en: We observe that diagnosis of silent errors can be effectively framed as a differential debugging problem by leveraging the existence of semantically correct reference implementations.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，通过利用语义正确参考实现的存在性，静默错误的诊断可以被有效框定为差分调试问题。

sentences.en: We propose Ekka, an automated diagnosis system that identifies root causes by systematically aligning and comparing intermediate execution states between a target and a reference framework.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Ekka，一个通过系统对齐并比较目标与参考框架之间中间执行状态来识别根本原因的自动化诊断系统。

sentences.en: We constructed a benchmark of real-world silent errors from popular serving frameworks, where Ekka shows 80\% pass@$1$ diagnosis accuracy and 88\% pass@$5$ diagnosis accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art systems.
sentences.zh: 我们从流行服务框架构建一个真实世界静默错误基准，其中 Ekka 展示 80\% 的 pass@1 诊断准确率与 88\% 的 pass@5 诊断准确率，超越最先进系统。

sentences.en: Ekka also diagnoses 4 new silent errors from serving frameworks, all of which have been confirmed by the developers.
sentences.zh: Ekka 还诊断了服务框架中的 4 个新静默错误，全部已由开发者确认。
